• "Save validation failed": The query engine rejected the definition. Common causes: aggregation referencing a field that's not in groupings, a filter operator the field doesn't support, or a field path that no longer exists.
  • Live preview empty: Try removing the filters one at a time to find which one excludes everything. Also check the dataset's Mode (live vs hybrid vs fact) — fact-only mode requires the fact rows to exist.
  • Field missing from picker: The dataset's field path list doesn't include it. Edit the CR_Dataset record (Setup → Custom Metadata) to add the path.
  • Save creates duplicate: Names must be unique. Pick a different report name or delete the previous one.
